item.title: The Quick Fall Into American Fascism
item.description: This flirting with fascism isn’t wise or pretty. I believe it’s the current political pursuit of the technocrats of which many are multi-billionaires, industrialists, security contractors and others.

item.title: Is Australia or the USA More Antisemitic? A Data Challenge.
item.description: This is your mission, should you accept: Where is antisemitism worse - the USA or Australia? Suggested paths of enquiry: google engrams of headlines, twitter polls, Pew etc., media coverage and the like.

item.title: Don’t Follow the True Believers of Fascism
item.description: I’m not ready to give up my vote for the ambitions of these Silicon Valley self aggrandised geeks any time soon. I would encourage you to keep an eye on them because they are definitely keeping an eye on you.

item.title: On Religion, Authoritarianism and Technology
item.description: Once a lie goes viral, it is truth. Efforts to dispel the lie leave less of a viral imprint. We are basically a populace at the mercy of humanity's impulse to lie and create outrage.

item.title: Iran’s Upheaval and the Test of Global Resolve
item.description: The Iranian people have never been this resolute in their objective, which is toppling the regime. The regime has already fallen in the minds of the public.

item.title: The Role of Friction in Society and Government
item.description: An illusion of social connection that is created by para-social relationships is adding to the loneliness epidemic as well as the downfall of democracy.

item.title: Restricting Opposition Activity After Voting in Uganda and Beyond
item.description: When opposition voices are constrained at this stage, core democratic principles begin to fray. Transparency suffers when leaders cannot freely address the public.

item.title: Sad to Say But the Trump Disaster is Worse Than We Expected
item.description: I don’t believe things can get better with Trump. I have no faith in his concern for our nation. I’m afraid that we won’t have a country left by the time he’s out of office.

item.title: Somaliland: A North-South Korea-like Divide… in Africa
item.description: With continued democracy and civic freedom, and now globalization and a start at international recognition, Somaliland's future is in the other direction: success!

item.title: Good News for Stephen Miller’s Fascists
item.description: Try something new. Possibly discover a whole universe of culture and imagination that’s waiting to embrace, and be embraced by you!
